scripts.text: I don't know much about magic, but do you know what tastes magical? ^CC6600Honey^000000!
scripts.translation: 我不太懂魔法，不过你知道什么东西的味道很神奇吗？^CC6600蜂蜜^000000！

scripts.text: It's soooo sweet and delicious. I'm not sure if it's an aphrodisiac, but I know for a fact that it will relieve you of fatigue and help you recover from wounds!
scripts.translation: 甜得不得了，又好吃！是不是春药，我不清楚，不过它确实能消除疲劳、帮助伤口恢复！

scripts.text: Hornets living in the grasslands spend their lives gathering nectar at the Queen Bee's command. Honey is made from the nectar they gather.
scripts.translation: 生活在草原上的蜂兵，在女王的命令下，一生都在采集花蜜。蜂蜜就是由它们采集的花蜜制成的。

scripts.text: But that's not all. There's a special kind of honey that's made for only Queen Bees to eat:
scripts.translation: 还不止如此。有一种特别的蜂蜜，只供蜂后享用：

scripts.text: Nothing can compare to the luscious flavor of Royal Jelly. And I think it's even better for you than ordinary Honey!
scripts.translation: 没有什么能比得上蜂王浆那浓郁的美味。我觉得它比普通蜂蜜对你更有益！

scripts.text: While I was researching magic, I discovered this mysterious scroll. It describes this tree named Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 研究魔法时，我发现了一份神秘卷轴，上面记载着一棵名叫世界树的树。

scripts.text: The leaves, seeds and fruit of Yggdrasil link every living thing in this world. According to this scroll, Yggdrasil is also involved in the creation of the world.
scripts.translation: 世界树的叶子、种子和果实，将世间所有生命联系起来。卷轴还说，世界树与世界的诞生有关。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, I've also heard of a rumor about a miraculous tree in some land near Comodo. They must be connected, I'm sure of it!
scripts.translation: 说起来，听说克魔岛附近也有棵神奇的树。两者一定有关，我敢肯定！

scripts.text: I sense the presence of a mighty spirit. Can it be you...?
scripts.translation: 我感受到一股强大的灵性力量，难道来自你...？

scripts.text: It seems that you are trained in the mystic arts. Magic... Its power is governed by the law of cause and effect.
scripts.translation: 看来，你修习过神秘的法术。魔法...它的力量受因果法则支配。

scripts.text: I see that you wield holy power in one way or another. I suppose Holy power may be considered one form of mystical energy.
scripts.translation: 看来你多少掌握着神圣力量。我想，神圣力量也可以算作一种神秘能量。

scripts.text: Although you may not be able to use magic or any other kind of powerful skills for now, this knowledge may be helpful in the future, young Novice...
scripts.translation: 年轻的初心者，虽然你现在还无法使用魔法或其他强大的技能，但这些知识将来或许能帮上忙...

scripts.text: Although you are not formally trained in the use of magic, you use skills which draw upon otherworldly energies, whether you know it or not...
scripts.translation: 虽然你没有正式修习过魔法，但你的技能也借助着异界的能量，无论你是否意识到...

scripts.text: If you use mystic energy for the purpose of harming others, or to defy the rules set by Mother Nature, that power will naturally be turned against you. Remember, you reap what you sow.
scripts.translation: 如果你使用神秘能量来伤害他人，或者违背自然之母制定的规则，那股力量自然会反噬于你。记住，种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

scripts.text: But there is an item that can protect the caster from ill consequence, allowing the safe use of certain magics. These are the shining, mystical stones known as Gemstones.
scripts.translation: 不过，有种物品能保护施法者，让人安全地使用某些魔法，免遭反噬。那就是闪耀着光芒的神秘石头——魔力矿石。

scripts.text: If you wish to use your powers to the fullest, remember this item.
scripts.translation: 想充分发挥自己的力量，就记住这件道具。

scripts.text: Somewhere in this world, there is a rare Staff which can transform psychic energy into physical force, endowing its owner with ^990000destructive power^000000...
scripts.translation: 这个世界的某个地方，有一根稀有法杖，能将精神能量转化为物理力量，赋予持有者^990000毁灭性的力量^000000...

scripts.text: With that, anyone could be as strong as Hercules... Even a weakling like me! Hahahahahah,
scripts.translation: 有了它，谁都能像赫拉克勒斯一样强壮...连我这样的弱者也行！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: I didn't say anything. But if
scripts.translation: 我什么也没说。不过要是

scripts.text: I did, forget all about it,
scripts.translation: 我说了什么，就全忘掉吧，

scripts.text: Is that an Orc Helm you're wearing?! That's so cool! Wow...
scripts.translation: 你戴的是兽人头盔吗？！太酷了！哇...

scripts.text: It's like you're surrounded by this incredibly masculine aura! Oooh~! You must be irresistible to all the girls!
scripts.translation: 仿佛笼罩着无比阳刚的气场！噢~！女孩们肯定都无法抗拒你！

scripts.text: Goodness, you must be so strong!
But I thought only members of the Orc Tribe could wear those?
scripts.translation: 可我以为只有兽人部落的人才能戴这种头盔？

scripts.text: Have you ever seen any Orcs from the Demi-Human tribe? If you go down southward from here, I think you can find Orcs in the deep forest.
scripts.translation: 你见过人形种族的兽人吗？从这里往南，应该能在森林深处找到他们。

scripts.text: I hear that Orcs have their own culture and language, supposedly just like us humans. Does that mean Orcs go on dates...?
scripts.translation: 听说兽人和人类一样，有自己的文化和语言。那他们也会约会吗...？

scripts.text: You know, where they tenderly whisper sweet nothings and then... Oh! I really want to know!
scripts.translation: 就是轻声说着甜言蜜语，然后...哦！好想知道啊！

scripts.text: Well, I wouldn't know. I've been studying too hard to become a Mage. I've been staying up all night, agonizing over anything that's magical.
scripts.translation: 不过，我也不清楚。为了成为魔法师，我埋头苦读，整夜琢磨那些魔法问题。

scripts.text: I especially worry about all the drawbacks to using magic.
scripts.translation: 我尤其担心使用魔法会带来各种弊端。

scripts.text: Oh darn! It was really annoying when a long-ranged enemy found me the last time I went exploring. That crummy monster disrupted the casting of all my spells! I didn't hit it at all!
scripts.translation: 真烦！上次去探险，被一只会远程攻击的魔物盯上了。它不停打断我施法，我连一下都没打中！

scripts.text: After that, I realized I needed some sort of weapon to counter long-ranged attacks from enemies. Something that can attack from a distance...
scripts.translation: 后来我明白了，得找件武器还击这些远程敌人。能隔着老远攻击的那种...

scripts.text: projectile launcher, preferably made out of wood.
scripts.translation: 远程武器，最好是木制的。

scripts.text: You wanna get your hands on some great stuff? Come on over!^000000
scripts.translation: 想弄点好东西吗？快过来！^000000

scripts.text: Hey there tough guy. You look smart enough to recognize a bargain when it's right in front of your eyes.
scripts.translation: 嘿，硬汉。你看起来挺机灵，应该能看出眼前这笔交易有多划算。

scripts.text: Well, well, well. Aren't you a pretty girl. Today just happens to be your lucky day!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，哎呀，你真是个大美女！今天正好是你的幸运日！

scripts.text: So just tell me what you want, and I'll cut you a deal from amongst my valuable, yet affordable, wares.
scripts.translation: 想要什么尽管说，我这儿的货既珍贵又实惠，还能给你算便宜点。

scripts.text: Gimme some potion so I can recover HP.
scripts.translation: 给我来点能恢复HP的药水。

scripts.text: Don't you have a good Manteau?
Don't you have something besides this?
scripts.translation: 你这儿就没有别的东西吗？

scripts.text: Here it is! High quality Red Potion! It starts working right away once you take it. Once it hits your lips, you can't stop. This stuff is that good.
scripts.translation: 给你！高品质红色药水！喝下去立刻见效。一旦入口，你就停不下来。这东西就是这么好。

scripts.text: C'mon dude. This is the latest Red Potion. I got it from a close friend of a friend, you know, a real dependable source, and it's real cheap too. You can't pass this up!
scripts.translation: 来嘛，兄弟，这是最新款的红色药水！从朋友的好朋友那里弄来的，货源绝对可靠，而且便宜得很。千万别错过！

scripts.text: Uh, can I buy White Potions instead?
scripts.translation: 呃，我能改买白色药水吗？

scripts.text: White Potions? Oh, those don't exist. But, er, if someone's selling that kind of stuff, bring it to me so I can, um, test the difference. But yeah, I got the real stuff.
scripts.translation: 白色药水？那种东西不存在！不过，呃，要是有人卖类似的东西，就带来给我...让我比较一下。总之，我这儿有真正的好货。

scripts.text: You can heal all your wounds by drinking Red Potions! And I'll sell you one for just ^FF3333500 zeny^000000!
scripts.translation: 喝红色药水可以治愈你所有的伤口！而且我只卖你50^FF33330 Zen^000000y！

scripts.text: Now, how cheap is that?! Since they're in such high demand, I can only sell you 100 of
scripts.translation: 看，多便宜啊！因为需求量大，

scripts.text: Ah duuuuuude~ You're breakin' my heart! I mean, at these prices, I'm practically performing charity!
scripts.translation: 啊，兄弟~你真是伤透了我的心！我是说，以这个价格，我简直是在做慈善！

scripts.text: W-waaaait! You didn't let me tell you the part about how Red Potions help you lose and gain weight in all the right places! Waaaaait!
scripts.translation: 等...等等！我还没告诉你，红色药水能让你该瘦的地方瘦、该胖的地方胖！等等！

scripts.text: I can't let you buy that many. I mean, it's not like, you know, there's a trace impurity in these Potions or anything like that...
scripts.translation: 我可不能让你买那么多。也不是说这些药水里有什么微量杂质之类的...

scripts.text: ^333333Now I gotta find some other sucker to dump this junk on!^000000 *Ahem* I mean, come again!
scripts.translation: ^333333我得找个别的冤大头把这些破烂甩出去！^000000 *咳咳* 我是说，欢迎下次光临！

scripts.text: What would a strong guy like you want a knife for? Those will just break under the force of your incredibly powerful swings!
scripts.translation: 你这么强壮，要小刀干吗？用力一挥，不就把它弄断了！
一把^FF3333有男子气概的短剑^000000。

scripts.text: A nice lady like you? Come on now, kitchen knives are for old naggy wives and the hired help.
scripts.translation: 像你这么漂亮的女士？拜托，厨刀是给那些唠叨的老婆和佣人用的。

scripts.text: ^FF3333French Dagger^000000 to match your beauty and elegance.
scripts.translation: ^FF3333法式短剑^000000，才配得上你的美丽与优雅。

scripts.text: The ^FF3333Main Gauche^000000! I invented it myself. And I'm only selling it for 9,400 zeny!
scripts.translation: ^FF3333笨拙短剑^000000！这是我自己发明的，只卖9,400 Zeny！

scripts.text: Aren't you going to give me a sheath too?
scripts.translation: 你不打算送我个剑鞘吗？

scripts.text: Whoa, that's almost asking too much! Alright, alright...
scripts.translation: 哇，这要求也太过分了！好吧，好吧...

scripts.text: Since I like you so much, I'm giving you a free sheath with your purchase! Now how's that
scripts.translation: 既然我这么喜欢你，就免费送你一个剑鞘！怎么样，

scripts.text: There's no way you can pass this up! Now, how many do you want?
scripts.translation: 你绝对不能错过这个机会！那么，你要买多少？

scripts.text: Man, how many chances of a lifetime have you passed up? Man, I hope you win the lottery...
scripts.translation: 哎，你到底错过多少次千载难逢的机会了？真希望你能中彩票...

scripts.text: I can't sell that many Daggers! That'll attract the Prontera Chiv--I mean, um, I was gonna donate some Daggers to... Hungry children?
scripts.translation: 我可不能卖那么多短剑！那会引来普隆德拉骑士——我是说，呃，我本来打算捐几把给...挨饿的孩子？

scripts.text: When the greatest deal in your life is right before your eyes?! Tragic, truly tragic...
scripts.translation: 人生中最划算的买卖就在眼前，你却要错过？！太悲惨了，真悲惨...

scripts.text: A Manteau? That's old news! You know what's the latest in protective armors?
scripts.translation: 斗篷？早过时了！你知道现在最新的防具是什么吗？

scripts.text: Now why would such a beautiful woman wear something out of style? You know what would make you look even better?
scripts.translation: 像你这么漂亮的女士，怎么能穿过时的东西？知道什么能让你更好看吗？

scripts.text: A Hood! Wearing one of those is the quickest way to win respect these days!
scripts.translation: 兜帽！如今想赢得尊重，戴上它最快！

scripts.text: If you've got a Hood on, monsters will fear you and run away in terror! And check out this sturdy fabric. I can pull it all I want and it won't tear!
scripts.translation: 戴上兜帽，魔物见了你就会吓得逃跑！再看看这结实的布料，随便怎么拉都不会破！

scripts.text: Haha! What are you saying? You don't need drawstrings! The space age Rayon and Nylon and Krypton fibers keep the Hood secure on your head!
scripts.translation: 哈哈！你说什么呢？根本不需要抽绳！太空时代的人造丝、尼龙和氪纤维，能让兜帽牢牢固定在头上！

scripts.text: So much technology was invested into this Hood. Can you believe I'm only selling it for 930 zeny?
scripts.translation: 这顶兜帽融入了这么多高科技，居然只卖930 Zeny，敢信吗？

scripts.text: Clearly, this is the deal of the century. So how many do you want?
scripts.translation: 这可是百年难遇的划算买卖！你要多少？

scripts.text: It wasn't because of the whole drawstrings thing, was it?
scripts.translation: 不会是因为没有抽绳吧？

scripts.text: I can't sell you that many! What are you trying to do, take advantage of me?
scripts.translation: 我可不能卖你那么多！你这是想占我便宜吗？

scripts.text: You sure like to ask for the impossible. Well, let me tell you right now. No other Merchant in the world sells the goods only I can offer.
scripts.translation: 你可真会强人所难。告诉你，我这些独家好货，别的商人根本买不到。

scripts.text: No need to look anywhere else at all when I clearly have the best items around!
scripts.translation: 最好的东西都在我这儿，还去别处找什么！

scripts.text: Please come back sometime, and buy more of my stuff. I love a customer who knows what they want! Hehe~
scripts.translation: 下次再来，多买点哦。我最喜欢知道自己想要什么的顾客！嘿嘿~

scripts.text: ^3355FFSomeday, you swear to yourself, you will have your bloody revenge on this belligerent drunk for besmirching the proud Mage profession. Someday...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你暗自发誓，总有一天，要让这个挑衅的醉汉为侮辱魔法师这一高贵职业付出代价。总有一天...^000000

scripts.text: Everyone knows Wizards are all intelligence and no strength! Come on, smart man! Show me how tough you are!
scripts.translation: 谁不知道巫师光有脑子、没半点力气！来啊，聪明人，让我看看你有多能打！

scripts.text: Silly Wizard! Only a monster like Baphomet can handle a big spell like th--
scripts.translation: 蠢巫师！只有巴风特那种魔物才扛得住这么大的法术——

scripts.text: I don't know what that is. But I guess it can't be half as bad as a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我不知道那是什么。不过，应该没魔法师那么糟吧。
我...我到底醉成什么样了？！

scripts.text: Man, I hate Mages with a passion! Always studying and chanting and making taxes high and stuff...
scripts.translation: 我可恨死魔法师了！整天研究、念咒，还害得税越来越高...

scripts.text: Taking our jobs, censoring the media, ruining our education system, causing air pollution, starting wars, making rap music...
scripts.translation: 抢走我们的工作，审查媒体，搞垮教育体系，造成空气污染，挑起战争，还搞说唱音乐...

scripts.text: Oh, I see. He's just some guy in the room to the left of me. He's always working on some sort of project.
scripts.translation: 哦，原来如此。他就住在我左边的房间里，总是在忙着做什么东西。

scripts.text: Something to do with these magic sort of Ear Muffs. I guess he's been looking for investors to help him finish building whatever he's making.
scripts.translation: 好像是在做某种魔法耳罩。他一直在找投资者，好把手头的东西做完。

scripts.text: Oh, alright. You can find Eric in the room to the left of me. He'll probably be happy to know someone is interested in what he's trying to build.
scripts.translation: 好吧，埃里克就在我左边的房间里。知道有人对他的发明感兴趣，他应该会很高兴。

scripts.text: From what I remember, he seemed really discouraged, thinking he'd never be able to finish his little project.
scripts.translation: 我记得他挺灰心的，觉得自己永远也做不完那个小项目。

scripts.text: I'm glad to hear you've come this way to help out that young fellow.
scripts.translation: 听说你特地来帮那个年轻人，我很高兴。

scripts.text: We've got some kind of Fortune Teller that's always hanging around in the corner, and a loud, belligerent drunk who's always picking on Mages.
scripts.translation: 我们这儿有个总待在角落里的占卜师，还有个吵闹又好斗、总找魔法师麻烦的醉汉。

scripts.text: If you're looking for alcohol, King Tristram III outlawed it a while ago. Now I hear they only serve it in certain places.
scripts.translation: 如果您想喝酒，特里斯坦三世国王前阵子已经颁布了禁酒令。听说现在只有某些地方才供应酒水。

scripts.text: Still, people manage to get drunk off the imitation drinks that we serve here. I guess it's all psychological.
scripts.translation: 不过，人们喝了这里供应的仿制饮料，照样能喝醉。我想这大概全是心理作用。

scripts.text: I reeeeally want to be able to visit that place where they serve real drinks. I hear it's just like paradise!
scripts.translation: 我真的好想去那个供应真酒的地方看看。听说那里简直像天堂！

scripts.text: Well, I've heard that they're opening a new Airship Service
scripts.translation: 嗯...听说朱诺要开通新的飞空艇服务

scripts.text: Or at least, they're planning to. The airship isn't really ready to take off just yet. In the meantime, there's some weird customer representative over there who's offering a teleport service.
scripts.translation: 至少他们是这么打算的。飞空艇还没准备好起飞。这段时间，那边有个古怪的客服代表在提供瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text: It seems like Kafra Corporation may finally have a competitor! Then again, I don't think many girls are as attractive as the Kafra Employees...
scripts.translation: 看来卡普拉公司终于有竞争对手了！不过，能像卡普拉职员那么有魅力的女孩可不多...

scripts.text: There are some new fashions floating around the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹王国最近流行起了一些新时尚！

scripts.text: People have been coming in, wearing some cute new hats. There was this cute Teddy Bear Hat I've never seen before, and a girl came in wearing these black Kitty Ears...
scripts.translation: 最近有人戴着可爱的新帽子来店里。有顶我没见过的泰迪熊帽，还有个女孩戴着黑色猫耳...

scripts.text: Of course, not every popular style suits my taste. I mean, I saw someone walking around with a Mushroom on their head. And I hear someone has been making hats made out of Fish?
scripts.translation: 当然，流行款式不一定都合我口味。我见过有人顶着蘑菇到处走，还听说有人拿鱼做帽子？
款式的帽子太有艺术感，

scripts.text: I hear there's this person somewhere in Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 听说卢恩·米德加兹某处有个人...

scripts.text: Tell me, have you ever heard of {0}? He's supposed to be the suavest hero around!
scripts.translation: 告诉我，你听说过{0}吗？据说他可是这里最潇洒的英雄！

scripts.text: Have you ever heard of {0}? People say she's one of the prettiest girls in all of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation: 你听说过{0}吗？人们都说她是卢恩·米德加兹最漂亮的女孩之一！

scripts.text: ^990000You get the hell away from my daughter, low-life, before I sell your organs for zeny!
scripts.translation: ^990000你这个下流胚子，离我女儿远点，不然我就把你的器官卖了换Zeny！
有那么一会儿特别低沉，

scripts.text: ^990000Hey you sex crazed bastard!! Stop looking at my daughter like that before I rip out your eyes, and eat them with pasta!^000000
scripts.translation: ^990000你这个色欲熏心的混蛋！！别再那样盯着我女儿看，不然我就把你的眼睛挖出来，拌意面吃！^000000

scripts.text: Oh, Dad must have possessed me again. It happens to me and my sister all the time.
scripts.translation: 哦，爸爸一定又附身到我身上了。我和姐姐身上经常发生这种事。

scripts.text: ^990000What part of ^FF0000I will whup you where you stand^000000 ^990000do you not understand?! Now, quit it you pervert!^000000
May I ask for a drink?
Is there any interesting gossip lately?
scripts.translation: 最近有什么有趣的八卦吗？

scripts.text: You know that we don't serve alcohol here anymore. We just have all these fake, flavorless drinks that have no effect. Yeah, they're pretty boring...
scripts.translation: 你知道，这里已经不卖酒了。只有些仿制饮料，没味道，喝了也没什么感觉。是啊，真没意思...

scripts.text: We pretty much only serve water around here. That, and really bad alcoholic imitation drinks.
scripts.translation: 这里基本只供应水，还有难喝的仿制酒水。

scripts.text: It's horrible that King Tristram III outlawed alcohol in the kingdom! It's probably the only bad decision he's made throughout his entire reign!
scripts.translation: 特里斯坦三世国王竟然禁止王国内饮酒，这太糟糕了！这大概是他整个统治期间做出的唯一一件蠢事吧！

scripts.text: I went down to the Prontera Sanctuary, and I could have sworn
scripts.translation: 我去普隆德拉圣堂时，简直敢肯定

scripts.text: that a Priest got married to a Priestess!
scripts.translation: 亲眼看见一位男牧师和女牧师结婚！

scripts.text: I really had no idea whether or not Priests could marry, but since King Tristram III was there himself,
scripts.translation: 我原本完全不知道牧师能不能结婚，但既然特里斯坦三世国王本人都在场，
我想这应该是被允许的吧！

scripts.text: I don't like to stereotype people, but haven't you noticed that Swordsmen and Knights
scripts.translation: 我不想以偏概全，不过你有没有注意到，剑士和骑士

scripts.text: I hear that it was originally called the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, after our continent. However, for some reason, the name was changed to 'Rune-Midgarts.'
scripts.translation: 我听说王国原本以大陆命名，叫作卢恩·米德加兹王国。不过不知为何，后来改名为“卢恩·米德加兹”。

scripts.text: It was obviously a wise decision, since too many people kept confusing the our continent with our kingdom. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation: 这显然是个明智的决定，毕竟太多人把大陆和王国搞混了。真奇怪，对吧？

scripts.text: I, I can't think of anything. E-everything feels so fuzzy...
scripts.translation: 我...我什么也想不起来。脑袋里一片模糊...

scripts.text: ^990000Stay away from my daughter, or I'll beat your brains out, punk! Elisa's gonna marry a doctor! Or a lawyer!^000000
scripts.translation: ^990000臭小子，离我女儿远点，不然我打烂你的脑袋！伊丽莎要嫁给医生！或者律师！^000000

scripts.text: It looks like a father's love endures forever, even in the afterlife.^000000
scripts.translation: 看来父爱至死不渝，即使离开人世也一样。^000000

scripts.text: It looks like a father's love endures forever, even in the afterlife.^000000
scripts.translation: 看来父爱至死不渝，即使离开人世也一样。^000000

scripts.text: ^990000How dare you try to pick up on my precious daughter! Do you wish to taste an angry father's fury?!^000000
scripts.translation: ^990000竟敢打我宝贝女儿的主意！想尝尝父亲的怒火吗？！^000000
以前还是个无聊的地方。

scripts.text: But now there are Mages and Wizards, and a flourishing
scripts.translation: 不过现在魔法师和巫师云集，
城里的经济也繁荣起来了！

scripts.text: Mages are wielders of magic. But you would know more about that topic now, wouldn't you?
scripts.translation: 魔法师是操纵魔法的人。不过关于这个话题，你现在应该更了解才对吧？

scripts.text: Mages and Wizards are always carrying books and studying magic. That's just the way they are.
scripts.translation: 魔法师和巫师总抱着书研究魔法，他们就是这样。

scripts.text: There's a Magic School in the NorthWest part of the city for Novices interested in becoming Mages. There, they can learn the basics of magic.
scripts.translation: 城市西北角有所魔法学校。想当魔法师的初心者，可以在那里学习魔法基础。

scripts.text: After becoming well experienced in the use of magic, Mages can become qualified to become Wizards.
scripts.translation: 积累足够的魔法经验后，魔法师就有资格转职为巫师。

scripts.text: Wizards have access to more powerful and destructive magic spells than Mages. Mages can apply to become Wizards at the top of Geffen Tower.
scripts.translation: 巫师可以使用比魔法师更强大、更具破坏力的魔法。魔法师可以在吉芬中央塔的顶部申请成为巫师。

scripts.text: Why, that's all thanks to Blacksmiths! But you should know that already, shouldn't you?
scripts.translation: .？这都多亏了铁匠！不过，你应该早就知道吧？

scripts.text: Well, I guess you can thank the Blacksmiths for the economy here in Geffen. Sure, they always dirty, sweaty, smelly and talk kind of rudely...
scripts.translation: 吉芬的经济繁荣，可得感谢铁匠。虽然他们总是脏兮兮、汗淋淋、臭烘烘，说话也粗鲁...

scripts.text: But they're hard working people. Also, the ores they refine and the weapons they create are high in demand.
scripts.translation: 但他们是很勤劳的人。而且，他们提炼的矿石和打造的武器需求量很大。

scripts.text: Adventurers pay Blacksmiths lots of their hard earned zeny for the high quality weapons that only they can create.
scripts.translation: 冒险者愿意花大把辛苦赚来的Zeny，购买只有铁匠才能打造的优质武器。

scripts.text: Me? I'm the world's most prettiest street merchant. Heh heh~
scripts.translation: 我？我可是世界上最漂亮的街头商人。嘿嘿~

scripts.text: But you can't even do that, can you?
Man, the Midgard continent sure is big! How's it going, youngster?
scripts.translation: 天哪，米德加尔特大陆真大啊！年轻人，最近怎么样？

scripts.text: This Geffen sure is strange. But it was worth it to travel here all the way from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 吉芬真是个奇特的地方。不过，从修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国一路赶来，倒也值得。
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国？

scripts.text: You know, ally of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Um... Our capital city is Juno?
scripts.translation: 就是卢恩·米德加兹王国的盟国啊。嗯...首都朱诺，总该知道吧？

scripts.text: Oh, you know, for business. It seems there's a lot of good money in foreign commerce.
scripts.translation: 哦，我是为了生意。看来对外贸易能赚不少钱。

scripts.text: I mean, all these new cities are being discovered by explorers, so import and export trade is really booming!
scripts.translation: 我的意思是，探险家们发现了许多新城市，所以进出口贸易非常繁荣！

scripts.text: You're in the trading business yourself, right? So of course you'd understand that we're in a Golden Age of trade!
scripts.translation: 你自己也做贸易，对吧？那你一定明白，我们正处于贸易的黄金时代！

scripts.text: Those kinds of concepts might be too high brow for a rookie like you.
scripts.translation: 这种道理对你这样的新手来说，可能太深奥了。

scripts.text: Have you been some of these new lands? They're really interesting and you can learn a lot of new things from these foreign cultures.
scripts.translation: 你去过那些新发现的地方吗？那里可有意思了，了解异国文化还能学到不少新东西。

scripts.text: Still, if you want to go sightseeing, I personally recommend that you visit my hometown of Juno. It's quite beautiful, you know.
scripts.translation: 不过，要是想观光，我还是推荐你去我的家乡朱诺。那里可漂亮了。

scripts.text: Don't tell me! You've come to have your fortune told, yes? I know,
scripts.translation: ..别告诉我！你是来算命的，对吧？我知道，

scripts.text: I know... I can see the future! So what kind of fortune do you want?
scripts.translation: 我知道...我能看到未来！那么你想看哪种运势？

scripts.text: Wow, that's a really broad category. But let me contact some spirits of the spirit world and I'll see what I can do.
scripts.translation: ..？哇，这范围可真广。不过，让我联系一下灵界的灵魂，看看能帮你算出些什么。

scripts.text: Alright, I got something. Ummmm, you will live to be very, very old. How old you ask?
scripts.translation: .好了，我看到了。唔，你会非常非常长寿。你问能活到多少岁？

scripts.text: ^333333*cough!*^000000ty-nine years old. Isn't that good news? That's a ripe old age, and you have plenty of blissful years left to enjoy.
scripts.translation: ^333333*咳！*^000000...十九岁。这不是好消息吗？那可是高寿，你还有好多幸福的时光可以享受呢。

scripts.text: Also, you'll always be successful. You'll successfully win in life and you'll successfully lose in life!
scripts.translation: 而且，你总会取得成功。你会在人生中成功地获胜，也会成功地失败！

scripts.text: You might not understand that little nugget of wisdom now, but as you learn more about this crazy, crazy world, it will make more sense.
scripts.translation: 你现在可能还不明白这句话的智慧，不过，等你多了解一些这个疯狂的世界，就会懂了。

scripts.text: What can I tell you about life? Let me contact the spirit world real quick~
scripts.translation: 关于人生，我能告诉你些什么呢？让我马上联系一下灵界~

scripts.text: Of course, I'm not sure exactly which dreams will come true, but hopefully the good dreams that you've had will become reality, rather than any of your weird nightmares.
scripts.translation: 当然，我还不确定究竟是哪个梦会成真。不过，希望是那些美梦变成现实，而不是你做过的怪异噩梦。

scripts.text: Which dreams exactly? Well, the spirits are awfully reticent today. They're not exactly in the mood to talk. Spirits have lives too, you know. Wait, did that make any sense?
scripts.translation: 究竟是哪个梦？唉，灵魂们今天格外沉默，不怎么想说话。灵魂也有自己的生活嘛。等等，我这话说得通吗？

scripts.text: I sense that you may be about to make a rash decision that you might regret. I must advise you to slow down and think first.
scripts.translation: 我感觉到，你可能快要做出一个让自己后悔的草率决定。听我一句劝，先缓一缓，好好想想。

scripts.text: Although the pressure may be high, remember that any decision made in excitement is usually a bad decision. Take a deep breath and relax.
scripts.translation: 压力可能很大，但要记住，情绪激动时做出的决定往往不明智。深呼吸，放松一下。

scripts.text: Even if you're running out of time, it's better to slowly plan things out so that you don't waste any of your efforts, or make costly mistakes.
scripts.translation: 就算时间紧迫，也最好静下心来做好规划，免得白费力气，或犯下代价惨重的错误。

scripts.text: is the key to overcoming crisis.
Hmmm... I sense that you are experiencing a loss of direction in life. Should you prioritize security or happiness?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我感觉到，你在人生的道路上迷失了方向。该优先追求安稳，还是幸福呢？

scripts.text: I suggest that you think fully and carefully before deciding what path is best for you. And remember, you can only learn from your mistakes.
scripts.translation: 我建议你仔细想清楚，再决定哪条路最适合自己。还有，别忘了从自己的错误中吸取教训。

scripts.text: If you plan carefully and perform positive, constructive actions with a good attitude, you can
scripts.translation: 只要认真规划，保持良好的心态，积极采取有益的行动，

scripts.text: I sense that you've had a quarrel with someone close to you. Someone for whom you care for dearly.
scripts.translation: 我感觉到，你和一个亲近的人吵架了。那个人对你来说非常重要。

scripts.text: You must take the initiative! Try and resolve this matter without getting too caught up in your emotions.
scripts.translation: 你必须主动出击！试着去解决这件事，不要让自己被情绪牵着走。

scripts.text: Try to make amends, swallow your pride and apologize sincerely if you have to. Isn't friendship worth it? I think so.
scripts.translation: 试着和好吧。放下自尊，该道歉就诚恳地道歉。为了友情，难道不值得吗？我觉得值得。

scripts.text: Well, I hope I settled any doubts you've had about the future. That is, after all, my job as a professional psychic consultant. Come back anytime~
scripts.translation: 希望我已经消除了你对未来的疑虑。毕竟，这就是我这个专业灵媒顾问的工作。欢迎随时再来~

scripts.text: You want to know your Love fortune? Oh ho~ Then there must be somebody that you like! Come on, you can tell me!
scripts.translation: 你想看爱情运势？哦吼~那看来是有你喜欢的人了！快说快说，告诉我吧！

scripts.text: Um, I sense a strong love energy emanating from your soul. It's quite intimidating and pushes away the weak and the spineless.
scripts.translation: ..嗯，我感觉到你的灵魂正散发着强烈的爱情能量。这股能量很有威慑力，会吓退那些软弱、没骨气的人。

scripts.text: So basically, I foresee that you'll only be attracting really strong people soon. You know, like professional athletes, bodybuilders, construction workers, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation: 也就是说，我预见你很快就只会吸引那些特别强壮的人。比如职业运动员、健美选手、建筑工人之类的。

scripts.text: So if this is what you want, congratulations! Fortune smiles upon you with joy this day.
scripts.translation: 如果这正是你想要的，那就恭喜了！今天，命运正欢欢喜喜地对你微笑。

scripts.text: But if this is the opposite of what you want, well, I'm sorry. Fortune smiles upon you with sarcasm this day. But it's not too late to change destiny!
scripts.translation: 可如果这与你的心愿恰恰相反，那我只能说抱歉了。今天，命运正讥讽地对你微笑。不过，现在改变命运还来得及！
让我联系一下灵魂，稍等片刻。

scripts.text: Ah! An old flame will return! I don't know if they'll fall in love with you again, ask you for money, or if that person's back for revenge...
scripts.translation: 啊！旧情人要回来了！我不知道对方是会再次爱上你，还是来找你要钱，或者是回来报仇...

scripts.text: But an old flame will definitely resurface in your life. Somehow. So if that's good news, congratulations! But, if that's bad news, then be careful!
scripts.translation: 不过，旧情人一定会以某种方式重新出现在你的生活中。如果这是好消息，那就恭喜你！可如果是坏消息，就要小心了！
你现在交往的那个女孩
你现在交往的那个男孩

scripts.text: We psychics are pretty accurate at this kind of thing. And it's so good to see that you're really happy with your partner!
scripts.translation: ..我们灵媒算这种事可是很准的。看到你和伴侣这么幸福，真替你高兴！

scripts.text: You didn't let me finish my sentence. What I meant to say was...
scripts.translation: 你还没让我把话说完呢。我想说的是...
如果你想让自己的余生悲惨到极点，那你现在交往的男孩简直是完美人选！

scripts.text: are currently seeing is perfect for you if you want to live the rest of your life in utter misery!
scripts.translation: 自己的余生悲惨到极点，那你现在交往的女孩简直是完美人选！

scripts.text: But even if you break up, do it as soon as possible and try to be good friends after the matter.
scripts.translation: 不过，要分手就尽早分手，之后也尽量做个好朋友。

scripts.text: It'll make better people out of both of you. But that's just what I think.
scripts.translation: 这样能让你们都变得更好。不过，这只是我的看法。

scripts.text: Sometimes, I get the future and the present mixed up. You know, since I'm always looking into the future...?
scripts.translation: 抱歉。有时候我会把未来和现在搞混。毕竟，我总是在看未来嘛...？

scripts.text: What I meant to say was
^3355FFyou and the perfect woman will soon fall in love^000000. Yes, that's what I meant!
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你很快就会和完美的女性坠入爱河。没^000000错，我就是这个意思！

scripts.text: What I meant to say was
^3355FFyou will soon be swept off your feet by the perfect guy^000000. Yes, that's what I meant!
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我想说的是，你很快就会被一个完美的男人迷得神魂^000000颠倒。对，我就是这个意思！

scripts.text: Looking for romance, eh? Life can always use a little more excitement.
scripts.translation: 在寻找浪漫吗？生活总是需要多一点刺激的。

scripts.text: That's strange, I foresee a Love Triangle in your future. No, wait! A Love...
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，我预见到你的未来里有一个三角恋。不对，等等！是...

scripts.text: What's the shape with eleven sides? Now, you can't expect me to know that off the top of my head. I'm a psychic, not a mathematician!
scripts.translation: 十一条边的图形叫什么来着？你可不能指望我张口就答得出来。我是灵媒，又不是数学家！

scripts.text: Love is always fun! Even in this bleak world, love surrounds us in its inviting glow. Treasure that person who is special to you, and come back for another reading!
scripts.translation: 爱情总是充满乐趣！即使世界如此灰暗，爱的温暖光芒依然围绕着我们。珍惜那个对你来说特别的人，记得再来找我占卜！

scripts.text: Money? Well, you must be more fortunate in money than I am. After all, I sit here all day and give this service for free!
scripts.translation: 财运？那你的财运肯定比我好。毕竟，我整天坐在这里，给人免费占卜！

scripts.text: Um, the spirits tell me that you might not win the lottery, no matter how many tickets you buy. I'm sorry, but it's true.
scripts.translation: ..呃，灵魂们告诉我，不管买多少张彩票，你可能都中不了奖。很抱歉，但这是真的。

scripts.text: But I just saved you a lifetime's worth of lottery tickets! That could be quite a hefty sum of money!
scripts.translation: 但我刚刚帮你省下了买一辈子彩票的钱！这可是一笔不小的数目！

scripts.text: Ah yes. Let me contact the spirit world. They usually have sound financial advice, despite the fact that don't have any sort of economy over there.
scripts.translation: 好，让我联系一下灵界。虽然那边连经济体系都没有，但灵魂们通常能给出靠谱的理财建议。

scripts.text: First off, be accountable for your own money and use a budget that works for you. A good rule of thumb? For every ten zeny you earn, put one zeny aside and either save it or invest it for later.
scripts.translation: 首先，要管好自己的钱，制定适合自己的预算。有个简单的办法：每赚 10 Zeny，就留出 1 Zeny，存起来或用来投资，为以后做准备。

scripts.text: And whatever you do, don't work as a psychic advisor in Rune-Midgarts. The real cash, apparently, is in discovering new countries. Why didn't I do that?!
scripts.translation: 还有，不管你做什么，千万别在卢恩·米德加兹当灵媒顾问。看来发现新国家才是真正赚钱的行当。我当初怎么没去干那个？！

scripts.text: So you want to know about money, eh? Let me commune with the spirits of the supernatural realm...
scripts.translation: 你想问财运，是吧？让我和灵界的灵魂们沟通一下...

scripts.text: Ah yes. They are telling me that it's best to be moderate in all things. Certainly, you must make sure that your expenditures don't exceed your budget.
scripts.translation: 啊，灵魂们说，凡事最好适度。当然，花钱可不能超出预算。

scripts.text: However, you should also avoid gambling with your money. By that, I mean you should save and invest carefully. Don't be tempted into risky get-rich-quick schemes!
scripts.translation: 不过，也别拿自己的钱去冒险。我的意思是，储蓄和投资都要谨慎。别被那些号称能一夜暴富的高风险计划诱惑了！

scripts.text: On the other hand, get-rich-not-as-quick schemes are okay, so long as you know what you are doing. I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation: 不过，只要你知道自己在做什么，那种“慢慢变富”的方案是可以的。我说的对吧？

scripts.text: Well, you need money to live, but having money alone isn't living. Don't forget that there are other important things. And try not to stress out, okay?
scripts.translation: 生活离不开钱，可光有钱也不算真正的生活。别忘了，还有其他重要的东西。也别给自己太大压力，好吗？

scripts.text: Your grades? You're still in school? I'm impressed! Your eyes tell me you are rather mature for your age. Alright, let me contact the spirits...
scripts.translation: 成绩？你还在上学？真让人刮目相看！从你的眼神来看，你比同龄人成熟得多。好吧，让我联系一下灵魂们...

scripts.text: Hm? All the spirits said was 'Did you study?' Well, I guess I answered your question with yet another question!
scripts.translation: 嗯？灵魂们只说了一句：“你用功了吗？”看来，我又用一个问题回答了你的问题！

scripts.text: You're asking me about your grades? That's weird. I mean, they only ask about your report card at school, right?
scripts.translation: 你要问自己的成绩？真奇怪。我是说，成绩单这种事，不是只有在学校才会有人问吗？

scripts.text: An education is really important, but don't be discouraged if your grades aren't as good as you'd like.
scripts.translation: 教育确实很重要，但如果成绩不如人意，也不要气馁。

scripts.text: Perhaps your style of learning isn't really supported by your school, or maybe you're not that interested in academics. Understandable.
scripts.translation: 也许学校的教学方式不适合你，或者你对课业没那么感兴趣。这都可以理解。

scripts.text: The spirits tell me that you should experiment with different learning styles, so that you can make sure that you get the grades that you want.
scripts.translation: 灵魂们说，你应该试试不同的学习方法，这样才能考出自己想要的成绩。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I just love doing that. Okay, let me ask the spirits for real this time. Hmmmm...
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉，我就是喜欢这样逗人。这次让我认真问问灵魂们。嗯...

scripts.text: Hmm. The spirits are being awfully rude today. They're saying, 'If you're so worried about your grades, why don't you ask your teacher?'
scripts.translation: 嗯，灵魂们今天真没礼貌。他们说：“既然这么担心成绩，干吗不去问老师？”

scripts.text: Now that I think about it, they do have a point. Why don't you ask your teacher, professor or whatever to see if you have any problems?
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，他们说得也有道理。你不如去问问老师、教授之类的人，看看自己有什么问题？

scripts.text: I mean, they're being paid to help you. And well, my service is free. So... Yeah.
scripts.translation: 我是说，他们可是拿工资来帮你的。我呢，提供的可是免费服务。所以嘛...你懂的。

scripts.text: I sense that you will soon be receiving straight A's...
scripts.translation: 我感觉到，你很快就能门门得A...

scripts.text: Now, I couldn't tell you what your real grades are. You might be destined to get an A in every class or subject, but if I told you that...
scripts.translation: 我不能告诉你将来究竟会考出什么成绩。也许你命中注定每门课都能拿 A，可要是我告诉了你...

scripts.text: You'd probably get cocky, slack off on studying, fail your classes and cause a time paradox. I mean, I have to actually be in the future to actually see it, you know?
scripts.translation: 你可能就会骄傲自满，不再用功，结果挂科，还引发时间悖论。我是说，我得真正身处那个未来，才能看见它嘛，你懂吧？

scripts.text: Instead of worrying about time paradoxes, why don't you make your own destiny?
scripts.translation: 与其担心时间悖论，不如自己创造命运吧。

scripts.text: Well, in any case, concentrating on your studies is tough, but it can be rewarding. I hope you do well in whatever you choose to do~
scripts.translation: 总之，专心学习虽然不容易，却能有所收获。无论你选择做什么，都希望你能做得出色~

scripts.text: The future? I thought it was implied that any fortune I tell you is about the future in the specific field that you choose.
scripts.translation: 未来？你选哪个方面，我就给你算哪个方面的未来，这不是不言而喻的吗？

scripts.text: I guess you want to know about the future in general. Let me commune with the spirits, and we'll see what they have to say, okay?
scripts.translation: 看来你是想知道未来的大致情况。让我和灵魂们沟通一下，听听他们怎么说，好吗？

scripts.text: In the future, Sex, Violence, and Rock and Roll are completely abolished. Mankind experiences an era of complete peace and utter boredom.
scripts.translation: ..在未来，性、暴力和摇滚乐将被彻底废除。人类将经历一个完全和平且极度无聊的时代。

scripts.text: I don't know how far in the future that will occur, but it better not happen soon!
scripts.translation: 我不知道那会在未来的什么时候发生，但最好别太快发生！

scripts.text: In the future, Earth is protected by a single giant robot: Plutonium Overdrive Ignition Negatron G a.k.a POING.
scripts.translation: 在未来，地球将由一台巨大的机器人保护：钚能超频点火负电子G，简称POING。

scripts.text: POING fights off many Kylorian invasions for years, until it is finally defeated by Dr. Hubris' Mechanical Overlord: Nyxltron 47.
scripts.translation: POING 多年来抵御了基洛里亚人的多次入侵，最后却被哈布斯博士的机械霸主——奈克斯特龙 47 击败了。

scripts.text: Luckily, Doctor Pyeus finishes the Gravitron Oblivion Drive for the Plutonium Overdrive Ignition Negatron G system just in time.
scripts.translation: 幸好，皮尤斯博士及时完成了适用于钚能超频点火负电子 G 系统的引力遗忘驱动装置。

scripts.text: And so, POING rises again, reborn as the Automatic Hero: GOD-POING. Of course, Nyxltron 47 is destroyed.
scripts.translation: 于是，POING 再度崛起，重生为自动英雄：GOD-POING！当然，奈克斯特龙 47 被摧毁了。

scripts.text: That's probably the most important thing you'll ever learn about the future. Trust me, the rest of it's boring.
scripts.translation: 这大概就是你能了解到的未来最重要的事了。相信我，其他的都很无聊。

scripts.text: In the future, believe it or not, the internet will be replaced by a giant brain. I don't know how, but trust me, this brain's huge.
scripts.translation: 在未来，信不信由你，互联网将被一个巨大的大脑取代。我不知道是怎么做到的，但相信我，这个大脑非常大。

scripts.text: Thanks to the number of internet web journals, this brain becomes peaceful, and decides not to take over the world as it originally planned.
scripts.translation: 多亏了网上的大量个人日志，这颗大脑变得平和，决定放弃原本统治世界的计划。

scripts.text: This weird brain thing definitely becomes a source for good, a loving benefactor to the human race, so long as people keep writing personal entries on the internet.
scripts.translation: ...只要人们继续在网上写个人日志，这个古怪的大脑就一定会造福人类，成为关爱人类的恩人。

scripts.text: In the future, they genetically engineer all sorts of plants.
scripts.translation: 未来，人们会用基因工程培育出各种各样的植物。

scripts.text: So many kinds! It's crazy I tell you!
scripts.translation: 种类多得不得了！我告诉你，简直疯狂！

scripts.text: Eventually, they create trees that grow celebrity impersonators. Today, it looks like a miracle of science, and a threat to Hollywood starlets.
scripts.translation: 最后，人们培育出了能长出名人模仿者的树。从今天的眼光来看，那简直是科学奇迹，也是对好莱坞女明星的威胁。

scripts.text: However, the people who buy these trees are the same kind who wear those really tacky shirts...
scripts.translation: 不过，买这些树的，都是那种会穿特别俗气的 T 恤的人...

scripts.text: You know, the kind with a lame sense of humor where it will have the word 'Cat-o-strophic' and there's this little kitten dressed like a mad scientist or something.
scripts.translation: 你知道吧，就是那种印着烂笑话的 T 恤。上面写着“猫难临头”，还画了一只打扮成疯狂科学家之类的小猫。

scripts.text: That's my prediction. Can you really argue with the wisdom of the spirit world?
scripts.translation: 嗯...这就是我的预言。你难道还能反驳灵界的智慧吗？

scripts.text: What does that have to do with matters of the supernatural? Well, um, let me contact the spirits. Ah! Here we go...
scripts.translation: ..？这跟灵异之事有什么关系？嗯，呃，让我联系一下灵魂们。啊！有了...

scripts.text: It was the most horrible vision!
It feels nice to wear expensive headgears! And it's nice to wear fancy clothing too! But remember...
scripts.translation: 戴上昂贵的头饰感觉真好！穿上华丽的衣服也很不错！但是请记住...

scripts.text: No matter how much zeny you may put into your wardrobe, you'll look silly unless you match the things you wear.
scripts.translation: 不管你在穿衣打扮上花多少 Zeny，要是搭配不好，看起来还是会很傻。

scripts.text: Now, here's a good example of a mismatched outfit. Imagine some Crusader wearing a Crown, Elven ears and an Iron Cain.
scripts.translation: 给你举个搭配不当的例子。想象一个十字军，戴着皇冠、妖精长耳朵饰和金属口罩。

scripts.text: Instead of looking cool, they look sort of like an Evil Keebler Prince. Spooky, huh?
scripts.translation: 非但不酷，反倒像个邪恶的饼干精灵王子。挺吓人的，对吧？

scripts.text: That Cowboy Hats will be very popular among female
Come on, wouldn't you agree? Cowboy Hats look great on Super Novices!
scripts.translation: 拜托，你也这么觉得吧？超级初心者戴荒野之帽，可好看了！

scripts.text: Sometimes, it's a cute idea to follow a theme. Like, if you wear both Angel Wing and Angel Wing Ears at the same time.
scripts.translation: 有时候，围绕同一个主题搭配也挺可爱的。比如同时戴上天使发圈和天使翅膀耳饰。

scripts.text: Of course, that might be too expensive for most people, but you get the idea.
scripts.translation: 当然，这对大多数人来说可能太贵了，但你应该明白我的意思。

scripts.text: I now predict that the Sombrero will be come very popular when a mass group of Bards form a guild in which the members only wear Sombreros.
scripts.translation: 我现在预言，要是有一大群诗人成立公会，所有成员都只戴墨西哥帽，那这种帽子就会大受欢迎。

scripts.text: Or was it the Feathered Bonnet that's supposed to skyrocket in popularity? Both of those hats are just sooo stylish, especially on Bards...
scripts.translation: 还是说，会突然大受欢迎的其实是羽毛帽？这两种帽子都太时髦了，尤其是诗人戴起来...
嗯...这就是我的预言。你难道还能反驳灵界的智慧吗？

scripts.text: We psychic consultants aren't really trained for fashion matters, but I hope I was at least a little bit of help to you.
scripts.translation: 我们这些灵媒顾问确实没受过时尚方面的训练，不过希望我多少帮上了你一点忙。

scripts.text: Hello, I'm the resident expert of Monsterology here in Geffen. Is there anything in particular that you're curious about?
scripts.translation: 你好，我是这里的魔物学专家。你有什么特别想了解的吗？

scripts.text: Well, as you may already know, since Wizards and Mages train in Geffen, monsters tend to stay away from the city. So tired adventurers are welcome to rest here.
scripts.translation: 你大概也知道，巫师和魔法师都在吉芬修行，所以魔物一般不敢靠近这座城市。冒险者累了，尽管在这里休息。

scripts.text: Still, if you want to seek out strong monsters, you can cross the bridge to the West and fight Kobolds.
scripts.translation: 不过，如果你想寻找强大的魔物，可以穿过西边的桥去和刺锤犬妖战斗。

scripts.text: You look strong enough for that kind of challenge. But if you see anyone more reckless cross the Western bridge, you might want to give them a warning.
scripts.translation: 看起来，你的实力足以应付这种挑战。不过，要是看到有人冒冒失失地过西边的桥，记得提醒他们一下。

scripts.text: Um, but if you're planning to go there, you better not go alone. I really recommend that you be well prepared if you're gonna fight those kinds of monsters.
scripts.translation: 不过，要去那里的话，最好别一个人去。想跟那种魔物交手，我真心建议你做好充分准备。

scripts.text: Well, the Juno Monster Museum is now open to the public. They have a fascinating exhibit and various monsters are now on display!
scripts.translation: 息？朱诺魔物博物馆已经对公众开放了。那里的展览很精彩，能看到各种各样的魔物！

scripts.text: I mean, I've read about all sorts of monsters in the Prontera and Juno Libraries, and encountered a few in the wild, but now I get a chance to see some strong monsters in real life!
scripts.translation: 我在普隆德拉和朱诺的图书馆读过不少介绍魔物的书，也在野外遇见过一些魔物。不过，现在终于有机会亲眼看看那些强大的魔物了！

scripts.text: What's also exciting is the exploration achieved by you adventurers for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 还有一件令人兴奋的事，就是你们冒险者为卢恩·米德加兹王国开拓探索的成果。

scripts.text: When a new land is discovered, there are usually unique monsters that are indigenous to that area.
scripts.translation: 每发现一片新土地，通常也会发现那里的独有魔物。

scripts.text: So new monsters are basically being discovered all the time! The variety of creatures that roam this world is really quite fascinating.
scripts.translation: 所以，我们几乎一直都在发现新魔物！这个世界上的生物如此多样，实在令人着迷。

scripts.text: The truth is that monsters have existed since ancient times. The Era of Monsters was when the power of the monsters was at its peak.
scripts.translation: 其实，魔物从远古时代就存在了。它们的力量在魔物时代达到了顶峰。

scripts.text: They've plagued humans for a long time, but were completely annihilated in a great war between mankind and the monsters.
scripts.translation: 它们长期祸害人类，后来在人类与魔物的一场大战中被彻底消灭。

scripts.text: However, as the balance of nature has changed, the monsters have inevitably returned. Not too many people know this, but most monsters were gentle creatures at one time. It's sad, really...
scripts.translation: 然而，随着自然平衡的改变，魔物还是不可避免地回来了。很少有人知道，大多数魔物曾经都是温顺的生物。真让人难过...

scripts.text: It seems that almost every monster around is composed of Jellopy. But is it just a crystallization made by some monsters, or is it... More?
scripts.translation: 杰勒比结晶。似乎周围几乎所有的魔物都是由它构成的。可它只是某些魔物形成的结晶，还是...另有奥秘？

scripts.text: From our research of ancient monsters and studies of recently discovered monsters, it seems that that traces of Jellopy cannot be found in stronger beasts.
scripts.translation: 我们研究了古代魔物和新发现的魔物，发现较强的魔物身上似乎没有杰勒比结晶的痕迹。

scripts.text: Still, may of us believe that there might be some relation to Jellopy and monsters, although it may be hard to believe that there is any.
scripts.translation: 尽管听起来难以置信，我们中还是有很多人认为，杰勒比结晶和魔物之间可能存在某种联系。

scripts.text: It's possible that Jellopy may be linked to a monster's personality and strength. So, if you mixed Jellopy with something, you'd create a stronger monster.
scripts.translation: 杰勒比结晶可能与魔物的性情和力量有关。如果把它与某些东西混合，也许就能创造出更强大的魔物。

scripts.text: Of course, doing that kind of experimentation just seems dangerous. You might be able to unleash some really scary monsters into the world...
scripts.translation: 当然，这样的实验实在危险。说不定会让一些极其可怕的魔物来到这个世界...

scripts.text: There was a skillful weapon smith
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰曾有一位技艺高超

scripts.text: in Al De Baran who had 4 sons.
scripts.translation: 的武器匠人，他有四个儿子。

scripts.text: Unfortunately he lost all of his sons
scripts.translation: 不幸的是，在研制一件强大武器时，

scripts.text: The father survived alone from the tragedy.
scripts.translation: 那场悲剧中，只有父亲一人幸存。

scripts.text: How sad it will be for the father...
scripts.translation: 那位父亲该有多伤心啊...

scripts.text: Because of the incident, the weapon smith
scripts.translation: 出了这件事以后，武器匠人

scripts.text: retired from his work and hid himself somewhere.
scripts.translation: 便退休了，躲到了不知什么地方。

scripts.text: After that, no one could ever see
scripts.translation: 从那以后，再也没人见过

scripts.text: the powerful weapon that he and his sons were developing.
scripts.translation: 他和儿子们正在研制的那件强大武器。

scripts.text: I don't think that 4 sons of him
scripts.translation: 我想，他那四个儿子的灵魂

scripts.text: went to the heaven with the anxiety.
scripts.translation: 仍心怀忧虑，没能升天安息。
